payload.description:
Feature: ClassifyProcedure token limits

Scenario: LLM classification forwards max_tokens
Given a ClassifyProcedure config includes max_tokens
When it builds the LLM-backed classifier
Then the underlying LLMModel receives the same max_tokens value

Scenario: LLM classification omits max_tokens by default
Given a ClassifyProcedure config does not include max_tokens
When it builds the LLM-backed classifier
Then the underlying LLMModel keeps its existing default token behavior
payload.title: ClassifyProcedure supports max_tokens
